name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), with toast feedback.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

added: Bind a Deep-Slumber setup to each loadout. Open the Loadout Switcher window, pick a loadout, and press "Bind current" to save the Deep-Slumber you're using — its cultivate line and phantom factors. With Auto-apply on, the plugin re-applies that setup automatically whenever you switch to the loadout.
